name: Murray AI — P1.2 Move to Leads Board

parameters.content:
## Phase 1.2 — Move to Leads Board

Creates a Leads Board item in the New Pipeline group with status `Contacted`.

**Inputs:** `lead_name`, `email`, `send_date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `subject_line`, `email_body_snippet`, `thread_id` (Gmail thread id from Phase 3 send).

### No find-and-replace needed — every id is read from env

```
MONDAY_LEADS_BOARD_ID=...
MONDAY_GROUP_NEW_PIPELINE=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_NAME=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_EMAIL=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_STATUS=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_SEND_DATE=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_SUBJECT_LINE=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_EMAIL_BODY_SNIPPET=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_THREAD_ID=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_FOLLOW_UP_1_SENT=...
MONDAY_COL_LEAD_FOLLOW_UP_2_SENT=...
```

Run **P1.0 Setup Helper** to print the exact `.env` snippet.

### Columns to add on Leads Board (one-time)
- **Thread ID** (text)
- **Follow Up 1 Date** (date)

### Credentials
- Attach a `Monday.com API` credential to the HTTP Request node.

### Output
`{ item_id, success }`
